channel.title: CVAnon — blind hiring & CV privacy notes
channel.description: Notes and short guides on anonymizing a CV, blind hiring, and keeping personal data out of your application.
channel.author: Vetro

item.title: Should you put your age or date of birth on your CV in 2026?
item.description: A short, honest answer: usually no. What a date of birth signals, why recruiters do not need it, and what to remove instead.

item.title: Blind hiring in 2026 — what to remove from a CV before you apply
item.description: A practical guide to anonymizing a CV for a blind application: what to remove, what to keep, and how to do it free without uploading your data.
